description.text: There would be Entrance Examinations for applicants: Date: Every July for International Students Contents: Theories of TCM, TCM Comprehensive, Chinese Language, Specialty Medical Insurance: 600 RMB/Year (1,000 RMB for 45 Year-old or Elder)

duration.text: The Prescriptions of TCM at Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Undergraduate school transcript 4.Bachelor's degree diploma

requirements.text: Applicant should meet one of the following requirements: TCM Bachelor's Degree; Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and Bearer of TCM or Acupuncturist License in his home country; Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, has been trained for TCM or Acupuncture, and been practicing them over 2 years; Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and has completed the designated courses.
